start: A workout open, the watch connected

user_sees: 'Well done. See the details on your phone.'
must_not: 'Start a workout on your phone' at once with no word that it was saved

steps.action: Discard the workout on the phone
user_sees: 'Start a workout on your phone' straight away

steps.action: Start a new workout on the phone within the 4 s
user_sees: The between-sets screen for the new workout

steps.action: Look at the watch after Finish
must_not: The workout's weights or names shown on the watch face for others to read

start: A workout open, the watch connected

user_sees: 'Well done. See the details on your phone.'
must_not: 'Start a workout on your phone' at once with no word that it was saved

steps.action: On the old version, do ""Workout saved" shown for about 4 s after Finish on the phone" up to step 1; update the app; open it and carry on.
user_sees: The journey carries on or starts again cleanly, with nothing lost that was saved
must_not: A crash on first open, a lost or half-saved saved data, or a step that the new version no longer understands

note: Older phone app never sends 'saved': the watch jumps straight back

start: A workout open, the watch connected

user_sees: 'Well done. See the details on your phone.'
must_not: 'Start a workout on your phone' at once with no word that it was saved

steps.action: Do step 1 of ""Workout saved" shown for about 4 s after Finish on the phone" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.
user_sees: Phone and watch show the same saved data within a few seconds
must_not: Two different values on phone and watch, a double saved data made by both, or the watch stuck on the old state

note: Finish on the phone, look at both

start: A workout open, the watch connected

user_sees: 'Well done. See the details on your phone.'
must_not: 'Start a workout on your phone' at once with no word that it was saved

steps.action: Turn the internet off at step 1 of ""Workout saved" shown for about 4 s after Finish on the phone", carry on, then turn it back on.
user_sees: A plain word that the work is saved on the device or could not be saved, and it is sent once when the internet is back
must_not: A lost saved data, a double saved data after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: Phone link drops right after Finish: the saved message may arrive late

steps.action: Set the device font to its largest size, then do ""Workout saved" shown for about 4 s after Finish on the phone".
user_sees: Bigger text that wraps; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach

user_sees: 'Well done. See the details on your phone.'
